descriptor.name: Virginia Parcels
descriptor.scope: Richmond capital-area sample of the statewide VGIN compilation; wider coverage untested.

evidence: Official VGIN layer metadata https://vginmaps.vdem.virginia.gov/arcgis/rest/services/VA_Base_Layers/VA_Parcels/FeatureServer/0?f=pjson explicitly identifies tax parcel boundaries representing legal descriptions recorded in local jurisdiction public documents; sanitized description and request evidence are in evidence/source-evidence.json.

Official identifier-only query of all three frozen VGIN_QPID values returns LOCALITY Norfolk City and FIPS 51710; exact safe rows and bounded query evidence are in evidence/source-evidence.json. Frozen packet records the same statewide VGIN endpoint and native IDs.
